children.name: COST_INCREASE_RATIO
children.comment: Cost is multiplied by this value, each wave.

children.text: Get the cost of an action.

children.functionDescription: Get the cost of an action.

parameters.value:
round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_REPAIR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_REPAIR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_REPAIR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))

round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_TURRET) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_TURRET) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_TURRET) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))

round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_SILO) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_SILO) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_SILO) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))

round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_SOLAR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_SOLAR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_SOLAR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))

round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_EXTRACTOR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_EXTRACTOR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus) )& " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_EXTRACTOR) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))

round(ArrCost.At(R_COPPER, A_TRANSMUTER) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_IRON, A_TRANSMUTER) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus)) & " " &
round(ArrCost.At(R_TUNGSTEN, A_TRANSMUTER) * (COST_INCREASE_RATIO ^ wminus))
